seo.title: Industrial IoT Platform | openIndu
seo.description: openIndu Industrial IoT Platform: an enterprise-grade IIoT for 3C electronics manufacturing, unifying device management, data acquisition, visualization dashboards, and traceability.

hero.subtitle: Let industrial data speak -- making smart manufacturing simpler

intro.heading: Platform Overview
intro.p1Prefix: openIndu is a community-grade Industrial IoT platform focused on 3C electronics manufacturing, covering the complete chain from
intro.p2Prefix: The platform consists of two parts: the
intro.p2Mid1: is a modern Vue 3 application that gives each role a personalized workbench and data dashboard; the
intro.p2Mid2: connects PLC equipment through multi-protocol edge gateways, enabling real-time acquisition and reporting of shop-floor data.

features.heading: Core Features
features.subheading: Six core feature modules, covering every smart-manufacturing scenario

smartLogin.title: Smart Login · Secure & Convenient
smartLogin.description: Phone-number verification-code sign-in/sign-up, secured by JWT token authentication.
details: Phone-code sign-in/sign-up; an unregistered phone number auto-creates an account
JWT dual-token authentication (Access + Refresh)
Fast entry into the workspace, one click to core functions
Fine-grained permission control -- different roles see different views
smartLogin.subtitle: Phone Code Sign-in · Secure & Convenient

workbench.title: Workbench · Global Overview at a Glance
workbench.description: Multi-dimensional data aggregation -- device status, line operation, and alerts, all at a glance.
details: Device overview: totals, online/offline counts
Line status: real-time operating status and utilization
Device-type distribution: loaders, AOI inspection, curing ovens, and more
Latest alerts: unresolved alerts shown in real time
Recent activity: audit-log traceability
Quick links: user management, role management, device list, data dashboard
workbench.subtitle: Workbench · Global Overview at a Glance

dashboard.title: Data Dashboard · Production Status on One Screen
dashboard.description: A dark, tech-styled data dashboard suited to shop-floor boards and command centers.
details: Key-metric cards: online devices, daily output, pass rate, equipment efficiency, alert count
Per-line device statistics: real-time display by production line
Production data overview: output trend, efficiency, quality, line status
Real-time alert log: instant push of anomaly events
Station defect-rate statistics: quality comparison across stations
Raw-material consumption monitoring: real-time material-usage tracking
dashboard.subtitle: Data Dashboard · Production Status on One Screen

deviceManagement.title: Equipment Management · Full Lifecycle Control
deviceManagement.description: Full-lifecycle management from device registration to decommissioning, with real-time monitoring and alerting.
details: Device search: filter by name, UUID, type, or production line
Device status monitoring: real-time operating-status tracking
Device alerts: closed-loop query and handling
Key parameters: real-time parameter monitoring and history tracking
Device maintenance: maintenance plans and record management
Device-type management: custom device-type configuration
deviceManagement.subtitle: Equipment Management · Full Lifecycle Control

traceability.title: Product Traceability · From Raw Material to Finished Product
traceability.description: A complete product-traceability chain, fully traceable from raw material to finished product.
details: Traceability lookup: query by trace number, product ID, or batch number
End-to-end traceability: complete records for every station, raw material, and process parameter
Process records: station in/out times, operator, equipment, and parameter snapshots
Material traceability: trace affected products by batch
traceability.subtitle: Product Traceability · Material to Finished Goods

miniProgram.title: WeChat Mini Program Support
miniProgram.description: Convenient mobile operation -- stay on top of production anytime, anywhere.
details: View device status and production data from the WeChat Mini Program
Mobile alert push and handling
Real-time sync with the web app
miniProgram.subtitle: WeChat Mini Program Support
